active.title: No active goals
active.body: Set a goal, then link tasks or milestones to track progress.

paused.title: No paused goals
paused.body: Pause a goal when it's on hold but not abandoned.

completed.title: No completed goals yet
completed.body: Finished goals stay here as your record.

abandoned.title: No abandoned goals
abandoned.body: Letting go of a goal is a valid decision. They're kept here.

archived.title: Archive is empty
archived.body: Archived goals are hidden but keep all their history.

mode.label: Measure progress by
mode.help_tasks: Completed linked tasks ÷ all linked tasks. Archived unfinished tasks don't count.
mode.help_manual: You set the percentage yourself — best when tasks don't reflect real progress.

fields.title: Goal
fields.successCriteriaHelp: A measurable finish line, e.g. “Pass the exam with 800+”.

progress.noDataHelp_tasks: Link a task to this goal to start measuring.
progress.noDataHelp_milestones: Add a milestone to start measuring.
progress.noDataHelp_manual: Add a progress update to set a value.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.add: Add a milestone, then press Enter
milestones.weightHelp: Higher weight = counts more toward progress.
milestones.deleteBody: This removes the milestone. Milestones with linked tasks can't be deleted.

tasks.title: Linked tasks
tasks.add: Add a task to this goal
